description: Khotiv is split between two maps: Ukraine_kyiv holds the village node 337524444 (wikidata Q4500392) and the village POI of boundary relation 4730394 with that wikidata; Ukraine_kyiv-city holds the same relation 4730394 as a village without wikidata (its admin_centre node is outside the region). The relation POI links the two village rows - osm id of one, wikidata of the other - so they are one row, followed by 'ZhK Novyi Khotiv'. ukraine_khotiv_region = the relation with its node and the residential area, ukraine_khotiv_city = the same relation without the node. Unit words after the house number (search rules object=building): 'поверх' (uk) and 'paw.' (pl). Without them the word matched a far POI ('Критий ринок, 2 поверх' in Oster, 'Paweł' in Zduńska Wola) next to a street of the same name ('вулиця Левка Лук'яненка', 'Pasaż Powstańców Śląskich'), and that row got one word more than the house. ukraine_kyiv_floor / poland_warsaw_pavilion = the address node, its street, the far POI and street, place nodes; the file name prefix gives the map its rules locale.
